g.text: access: always on (this is the default)
QWERTY letters · home-row mods (yellow) · Caps Word (pink) · layer-tap to POINTER (blue)
access: hold Z (left) or hold / (right) — release to exit
Trackpad & mouse controls · mirrored modifiers · maintenance keys (EE_CLR, QK_BOOT)
access: hold left-thumb Bksp (tap = Backspace, hold = LOWER) · Phase 2
Symbols (top row) · numpad (right hand) · RGB controls (outer column) · backup mods (home row)
access: hold right-thumb Del (tap = Delete, hold = RAISE) · Phase 2
F-keys (top row) · arrow cluster + Home/End/PgUp/PgDn (left) · media + mirrored mods (right)
